annotation.justification: The clause provides a clear and unambiguous instruction for intermediaries handling the Max-Forwards header. It specifies that the intermediary must generate an updated Max-Forwards field with a value that is the lesser of the received value decremented by one or the recipient's maximum supported value. There is no ambiguity in the implementation behavior required by this clause.
